title: Quaint Apt. 3 mi to DT & 1 mi to HillsboroVillage
description:
We have just replaced the unit with a brand new LEESA mattress and a new queen sized bed! Pictures will be updated soon. 

This upstairs apartment is a perfect stay whether traveling for work, visiting as a tourist, or just passing through. The apartment is located less than a mile from Hillsboro Village- bars, restaurants, pancake pantry, boutiques and MORE! The bathroom tile has been updated in Jan 2020 along with new fixtures in the bathroom!

The space
The space has all of your basic needs!

Guest access
Guests will have access to wifi, cable, a coffee maker, microwave, oven, stove, hanging closet space, dining area, living area, and shower/tub.
